about.label: Developers and consultants on one team
about.title: We build products.
about.intro: MidnaTech is a consulting and development team. We design, build and integrate custom software, data and AI systems around the way an operation actually runs.
about.quote: We take responsibility for the systems we design, build and refine, whether they carry our name or yours.

services.title: Consulting and Engineering Under One Roof
services.intro: One team of developers and consultants, from the first conversation through launch and beyond.

items.title: Custom Software
items.detail: Web and mobile apps designed around the work your staff and customers actually do, instead of forcing them into an off-the-shelf tool.

items.title: Connected Systems
items.detail: We connect the tools, devices and vendor platforms you already pay for, so your team works from one picture instead of five logins.

items.title: Data You Can Act On
items.detail: We turn the data you already collect into scores, reports and alerts that tell you where to look first.

items.title: Practical AI
items.detail: AI that explains what your data is flagging in plain language, so the next step is clear to the person who has to take it.

items.title: Built to Keep Running
items.detail: Systems set up to stay fast and available as your operation grows, and straightforward for your team to live with.

items.title: Compliance Consulting
items.detail: Guidance on electronic logging device (ELD) certification, hours-of-service rules and fleet compliance programs.

work.title: What We've Built
work.intro: Each of our own products started as an operational problem. They show the kind of system we can design around yours.

items.name: FleetSense
items.headline: Know What Your Fleet Needs First
items.summary: Turns the vehicle and camera data a fleet already collects into a short list of what needs attention, who needs coaching and what it is costing.
features: The issues that matter most, each explained in plain language
A clear view of what fuel waste and vehicle wear are costing
Driver coaching backed by video of the actual event
Scores and coaching notes drivers can see on their own phone

items.name: Elevate
items.headline: Automated AI Coaching for Safer Drivers
items.summary: Flags the drivers who need coaching, explains what happened in plain language and tracks every follow-up through to resolution, so nothing falls through the cracks.
features: AI summaries that explain each incident in plain language
Alerts from different devices combined into one incident
Risk scores that show who needs attention first

items.name: ELD Certification Validation Tool
items.headline: Walk Into Certification Prepared
items.summary: Lets device makers check how an electronic logging device behaves before submitting it for certification, so gaps are found early instead of during formal testing.
features: Device behavior checked against certification requirements
Gaps found and fixed before formal testing
A quick recheck after every software update

custom.name: Custom build
custom.headline: A System Built Around Your Operation
custom.summary: Bring us the operational problem and we'll design, build and connect the system around it.
features: Shaped around how your team works, not a template
Connected to the tools you already rely on
Built by the same team behind the products on this page
